analyses.expression: i_error = responsivity * input_power * abs(T) * sin(arg(T) - phase)
analyses.frequency_units: Hz for gains labelled per Hz; omega is rad/s and requires explicit 2*pi conversion
analyses.normalized_gain: current gain divided by responsivity and defined input power
analyses.voltage_gain: current gain times complex TIA transfer; real scalar permitted only in qualified flat band

analyses.implementation: validation of authored synthetic arrays; no FFT, digitizer or frequency extraction

analyses.expression: sqrt(integral of one-sided S_frequency over declared positive-frequency bounds)
analyses.lower_bound: explicit analyzed support; no extrapolation to DC
analyses.source_integration_details: exact raw windows and uncertainty not supplied
analyses.implementation: trapezoidal integration over complete authored grid

analyses.definition: Identify every isolated unity crossing with direction and all unity plateaus; report first downward crossing as a candidate with explicit ambiguity
analyses.implementation: Scaled piecewise-linear root interpolation; upward crossings, endpoint equalities, touches, plateaus, multiple crossings and absent crossings remain explicit

analyses.expression: sqrt(8*ln(2)*integral of S(f) where S(f) exceeds beta line over declared support)
required: report finite-band estimate and missing tails
analyses.implementation: piecewise-linear clipped-segment integration of authored synthetic PSD

noise_terms: intrinsic laser noise filtered by loop
electronics plus detector shot noise referred through discriminator
assumptions: high loop gain approximation only within justified band
finite bandwidth and laser/driver response retained

in_loop_interpretation: Laser relative to cavity; cannot independently prove absolute frequency noise, suppress cavity TRN or establish linewidth
